interface_hashing.artifact_rule: When a node passes, serialize its exact nonempty interface object as a standalone UTF-8 JSON artifact and hash the artifact file bytes. An empty correspondence is represented by a nonempty coverage-cell list with an empty typed record payload and a nonexistence certificate.
interface_hashing.pending_rule: Pending nodes have null coverage-cell collections and omit artifact_path, artifact_hash, dependency_hashes, frozen, and reviews.

freeze_gate_schema.review_hash_rule: Each review artifact_hash exactly matches the node artifact_hash.
freeze_gate_schema.topological_readiness_scope: Frozen dependencies are necessary but never sufficient author authorization; the contract Section 11 is the sole authority for author gates.

invalidation_rule.interface_change: A changed frozen interface hash invalidates every transitive descendant.
invalidation_rule.descendant_reset: Reset each invalidated descendant to pending and remove stale results, artifact paths, artifact hashes, dependency hashes, execution-order fields, and reviews.
invalidation_rule.contract_change: A change covered by Section 12 reopens Gate 0 and invalidates all six derivation nodes.
invalidation_rule.terminal_benchmark: N7 has no derivation descendants. A finding confined to its benchmark result invalidates N7 and migration consumers, not the frozen private-information model; a shared-contract error follows contract_change.

coverage_cell_v1.exists_rule: The family-specific record field is a nonempty list and nonexistence_certificate is null.
coverage_cell_v1.none_rule: The family-specific record field is an empty list and nonexistence_certificate is nonnull with nonempty ledger_claim_ids.
coverage_cell_v1.domain_rule: Cells are mutually exclusive and exhaustive over the declared interface domain.

public_payoff_vector_v1.hegemon_payoff_rule: Scalar because each public-equilibrium record fixes theta.

private_information_comparison_v1.private_rule_passthrough_rule: Each N3 equilibrium record appears exactly once in majority private_rule_cells and each N4 equilibrium record appears exactly once in unanimity private_rule_cells, preserving source cell id, equilibrium id, and interface hash; one rule may be nonempty when the other is empty.
private_information_comparison_v1.source_cardinality_rule: Each record cites exactly one N3 majority equilibrium id, exactly one N4 unanimity equilibrium id, and their matching interface hashes; each admissible source pair appears exactly once.
private_information_comparison_v1.comparison_refinement_rule: comparison_cells is the common refinement of majority and unanimity private_rule_cells and is none wherever either source cell is none, without changing either private-rule collection.

complete_information_benchmark_v1.public_continuation_rule: R2 source_public_continuation_ids is empty; R1 contains all and only consumed R2 public_equilibrium_ids from the same institution and type.
complete_information_benchmark_v1.rent_tuple_rule: Exactly one rent record per admissible same-institution tuple of one private-rule record, two R1 public equilibrium ids (one per type), and the frozen N6 interface hash; majority and unanimity rent collections remain independent.
complete_information_benchmark_v1.rent_independence_rule: RI_M and RI_U are represented in separate coverage-cell collections; either may be nonempty when the other is empty.
complete_information_benchmark_v1.contrast_tuple_rule: Exactly one contrast record per admissible majority-unanimity rent-record pair; the contrast cell is none wherever either source rent cell is none, without changing either rent collection.

correspondence_cells.domain_conditions: m=2, nu=0, beta in (0,1), 0<o_0<o_1<1, and o_1<=y_bar<=1. Define a0=beta*(1-o_0)/2, z=beta*(1-o_1)/2, p=1-beta*o_1-z, u0=1-beta*o_0-z, q2=1-beta*o_0-a0, k2=max{0,1-beta*o_1-a0}, e2=z, s=z, and L2=max{k2,e2}.

equilibrium_records.admissibility_conditions: Each proposer identity chooses one local option: low-only passage; pooling passage; delay when k2<=a0; or a low-only/delay proposal mixture when k2<=a0. Low-only support has beta*o_0<=Y_i<beta*o_1, x_j>=z, L2<=R_i<=u0, feasibility, and common (R_i,Y_i). Pooling support has Y_i>=beta*o_1, x_j>=z, L2<=R_i<=p, feasibility, and common (R_i,Y_i); equality R_i=L2 requires Y_i=beta*o_1. The local low-only/delay mixture uses R_i=a0 and Y_i=beta*o_0. Pooling never mixes locally with another branch.
equilibrium_records.branch_classification: complete zero-prior m=2 correspondence: low-only passage, pooling passage, conditional delay, the admissible low-only/delay tie, and full Cartesian proposer-identity closure

strategy_profile.recognized_weak_proposers: For each identity i, F_i is supported on its selected local option. Accepted support has a common proposer payoff R_i and common offer Y_i within each accepted branch; weak allocations and slack may vary subject to feasibility. Delay support gives i a0.
strategy_profile.local_option_set: Pure low-only; pure pooling; if k2<=a0, pure delay or a low-only/delay mixture at (R_i,Y_i)=(a0,beta*o_0). Different identities may select different local options in one global assessment.
strategy_profile.weak_nonproposer_ballot: Yes on accepted support. Delay is implemented either by H rejection with y<beta*o_0, where the sole weak yes is undominated without an x restriction because a0>z, or by exactly one weak rejection with x_j<a0. Every null proposal uses the exhaustive m=2 response partition defining L2.

hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_0: Yes on low-only and pooling support; in H-rejection delay the low type says no, and in weak-rejection delay it says yes.
hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_1: No on low-only support, yes on pooling support, and uses the same pooling action as theta_0 within each delay subfamily; T^Y governs genuine equality.

strategy_profile.proposal_mixing: Degenerate, discrete, or atomless mixing within a local branch; the only cross-branch local mixture is low-only/delay at the stated tie. Cross-identity combinations are the Cartesian product of the linked local assessments.

belief_system.on_path: Weak actions are type-independent. Accepted proposals pass. Every delayed proposal leaves posterior zero and enters N2-EQ-LOW-TYPE-ONLY.
belief_system.zero_probability: For x<a0, weak rejection plus nonpivotal off-path H separation gives s=z. For x>=a0, endpoint/high rejection gives at most e2=z and y>=beta*o_1 forces at most k2. The endpoint and forced-passage packages establish L2=max{k2,e2} exactly.
belief_system.atomless_convention: Bayes holds on positive-measure proposal events and for a regular conditional version F_i-almost everywhere; every exact null proposal has an explicit pointwise ballot belief, and every pure proposer deviation is evaluated under the true prior.
belief_system.weak_vote_passive_lemma: Weak actions are uninformative only on positive-probability histories; no off-path weak-vote-passive restriction is imposed.

equilibrium_records.existence_uniqueness_status: Exists for every admissible primitive vector. The record is the full atomic correspondence in this cell; packages, slack, within-branch mixing, conditional low-only/delay mixing, identity products, and null-history beliefs remain set-valued.
equilibrium_records.selection_status: Within each identity, accepted support has common tie-break-minimal Y_i. The low-only/delay mixture is retained only at equal proposer and expected-H payoffs. Pooling cannot mix locally with low-only or delay. No additional selection is imposed.
equilibrium_records.recognized_proposer_payoff: For identity i, V_i=lambda_i^L*R_i^L+lambda_i^P*R_i^P+lambda_i^D*a0, with local masses restricted by the stated option set.
equilibrium_records.weak_nonproposer_pre_recognition_expecte: For weak identity k, [V_k+sum_{i!=k}{X_ki+lambda_i^D*a0}]/2, where X_ki is k's F_i-expected current allocation on accepted low-only and pooling components.

correspondence_cells.domain_conditions: m=2 and 0<nu<=nu_2, where nu_2=(o_1-o_0)/(1-o_0). Define a0, z, d=(1-nu)*a0, g=d, p, q2, k2, e2=min{z,(1-nu)*q2}, s=(1-nu)*z, and L2=max{k2,e2}.

equilibrium_records.admissibility_conditions: Pooling always exists. Its support has Y_i>=beta*o_1, x_j>=z, L2<=R_i<=p, feasibility, and common (R_i,Y_i). For nu<1, equality R_i=L2 is excluded exactly when L2=(1-nu)*q2<z; every retained equality requires Y_i=beta*o_1. Delay exists iff k2<=d. Each identity selects pure pooling or, when admissible, pure delay; no within-identity cross-branch mixture survives in this low N2 region.
equilibrium_records.branch_classification: complete positive-prior low-N2 m=2 correspondence: universal pooling, conditional delay, no pure separation, and Cartesian identity closure without local cross-branch mixing

strategy_profile.local_option_set: Pure pooling always; pure delay iff k2<=d. Proposal-level lower-H tie-breaking forbids a pooling/delay mixture because delay enters low-only N2 and gives H strictly less.
strategy_profile.weak_nonproposer_ballot: Yes on pooling support. Delay uses H rejection with y<beta*o_0 or exactly one weak rejection with x_j<d; at nu<nu_2 the H-rejection weak yes needs no coordinate bound, while at nu=nu_2 it requires x_j>=z. Null proposals use the exhaustive m=2 L2 response partition.

hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_0: Yes on pooling support; no in H-rejection delay and yes in weak-rejection delay.
hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_1: Same on-path action as theta_0 in pooling and within each delay subfamily; positive-prior separating ballots do not survive.

strategy_profile.proposal_mixing: Degenerate, discrete, or atomless within the selected local branch. Different identities may select pooling or delay, producing the full Cartesian identity product in one assessment.

belief_system.on_path: Pooling proposals pass. Delay proposals preserve posterior nu and enter N2-EQ-LOW-TYPE-ONLY; weak actions add no information.
belief_system.zero_probability: For x<a0, weak rejection with low-H-no/high-H-yes nonpivotal separation gives s=(1-nu)z<=e2. For x>=a0, endpoint/high rejection or forced passage gives at most e2 or k2. Thus every pure deviation is capped at L2=max{k2,e2}.
belief_system.atomless_convention: Bayes holds on positive-measure proposal events and F_i-almost everywhere; every exact null proposal has a pointwise belief and every pure proposer deviation uses the true prior.
belief_system.weak_vote_passive_lemma: Derived on path only; zero-probability proposal and vote-vector beliefs remain unrestricted.

equilibrium_records.existence_uniqueness_status: Exists for every parameter vector. Pooling makes the cell nonempty; delay is an additional local option exactly when k2<=d. Identity products, packages, branch-internal mixing, slack, and beliefs remain multiple.
equilibrium_records.selection_status: Accepted support uses common tie-break-minimal Y_i. Low-H equality bounds are open as stated. Delay cannot mix locally with pooling, but different proposer identities may choose different pure local branches.
equilibrium_records.recognized_proposer_payoff: V_i=lambda_i^P*R_i^P+lambda_i^D*d, where (lambda_i^P,lambda_i^D) is either (1,0) or, if k2<=d, (0,1).
equilibrium_records.weak_nonproposer_pre_recognition_expecte: For weak identity k, [V_k+sum_{i!=k}{X_ki+lambda_i^D*d}]/2, with X_ki the accepted-pooling current allocation weighted by F_i.

correspondence_cells.domain_conditions: m=2 and nu_2<nu<=1. Define a0, z, d=(1-nu)*a0<z, g=z, p, q2, k2, e2=min{z,(1-nu)*q2}, s=(1-nu)*z, and L2=max{k2,e2}.

equilibrium_records.admissibility_conditions: Pooling always exists. Support has Y_i>=beta*o_1, x_j>=z, L2<=R_i<=p, feasibility, and common (R_i,Y_i). For nu<1, equality R_i=L2 is excluded only when L2=(1-nu)*q2<z; every retained equality requires Y_i=beta*o_1. Delay exists iff k2<=z. When delay exists, a local pooling/delay mixture is admissible exactly at R_i=z and Y_i=beta*o_1. Pure pooling and pure delay are also retained.
equilibrium_records.branch_classification: complete high-N2 m=2 correspondence: universal pooling, conditional delay, the admissible pooling/delay tie, no pure separation, and full Cartesian identity closure

strategy_profile.recognized_weak_proposers: Each identity selects pooling, conditional delay, or their conditional boundary mixture. Accepted pooling support has common (R_i,Y_i); delay support yields z.
strategy_profile.local_option_set: Pure pooling always. If k2<=z: pure delay and any pooling/delay proposal mixture at (R_i,Y_i)=(z,beta*o_1).
strategy_profile.weak_nonproposer_ballot: Yes on pooling support. Delay uses H rejection with y<beta*o_1 and x_j>=z, or exactly one weak rejection with x_j<z. Null proposals use the complete m=2 L2 response partition.

hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_0: Pools with theta_1: yes on pooling; no in H-rejection delay; yes in weak-rejection delay.
hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_1: Same on-path action as theta_0; T^Y applies at y=beta*o_1 and at nonpivotal continuation equality.

strategy_profile.proposal_mixing: Degenerate, discrete, or atomless within branches. Cross-branch proposal mixing is allowed only at the stated common proposer/H payoff; identities otherwise combine their local options by Cartesian product.

belief_system.on_path: Pooling proposals pass. Delayed proposals preserve posterior nu and enter N2-EQ-POOLING. Weak actions are uninformative.
belief_system.zero_probability: For x<a0, weak rejection with nonpivotal off-path H separation gives s=(1-nu)z. For x>=a0, endpoint/high rejection or forced passage caps the proposal at e2 or k2. Every null deviation is therefore capped at L2=max{k2,e2}.
belief_system.atomless_convention: Bayes holds on positive-measure proposal events and F_i-almost everywhere; exact null proposals have pointwise beliefs and pure deviations use the true prior.
belief_system.weak_vote_passive_lemma: Derived on path only; no passive off-path assessment is imposed.

equilibrium_records.existence_uniqueness_status: Exists for every parameter vector. Pooling is universal; delay and the within-identity pooling/delay mixture exist exactly when k2<=z. The record retains package, mixing, identity-product, slack, and belief multiplicity.
equilibrium_records.selection_status: Accepted support has common tie-break-minimal Y_i. The local pooling/delay mixture survives only at equal proposer payoff z and equal H payoff beta*o_1. No extra selection is used.
equilibrium_records.recognized_proposer_payoff: V_i=lambda_i^P*R_i^P+lambda_i^D*z. If both masses are positive, R_i^P=z and Y_i=beta*o_1.
equilibrium_records.weak_nonproposer_pre_recognition_expecte: For weak identity k, [V_k+sum_{i!=k}{X_ki+lambda_i^D*z}]/2, with X_ki the accepted-pooling current allocation weighted by F_i.

correspondence_cells.domain_conditions: m>=3, nu=0, beta in (0,1), 0<o_0<o_1<1, and o_1<=y_bar<=1. Define a0, z, p, u0, s=(1-nu)*z=z, and L3=s=z.

equilibrium_records.admissibility_conditions: Each identity chooses low-only passage, pooling passage, delay, or the low-only/delay boundary mixture. Low-only support has beta*o_0<=Y_i<beta*o_1, every x_j>=z, z<=R_i<=u0, feasibility, and common (R_i,Y_i). Pooling support has Y_i>=beta*o_1, every x_j>=z, z<=R_i<=p, feasibility, and common (R_i,Y_i); equality R_i=z requires Y_i=beta*o_1. Delay always exists. The local low-only/delay mixture uses R_i=a0 and Y_i=beta*o_0.
equilibrium_records.branch_classification: complete zero-prior m>=3 correspondence: low-only, pooling, universal delay, the low-only/delay tie, and full Cartesian proposer-identity closure

strategy_profile.recognized_weak_proposers: Each identity selects one local option; accepted support has common proposer payoff and common offer within each branch, while delay support yields a0.
strategy_profile.local_option_set: Pure low-only, pure pooling, pure delay, or any low-only/delay proposal mixture at (R_i,Y_i)=(a0,beta*o_0).
strategy_profile.weak_nonproposer_ballot: Yes on accepted support. Delay uses H rejection with y<beta*o_0, exactly one weak rejector with x_j<a0, or two or more weak rejectors; the multiple-rejector profile is strict because a0>z. Null-proposal punishment uses the L3 construction.

hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_0: Yes on accepted support; no in H-rejection delay and yes after weak rejection.
hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_1: No on low-only, yes on pooling, and uses the same subfamily-contingent action as theta_0 in delay.

strategy_profile.proposal_mixing: Degenerate, discrete, or atomless branch mixing, with the sole local cross-branch tie low-only/delay. Identities combine by Cartesian product in one assessment.

belief_system.on_path: Weak actions are uninformative. Accepted proposals pass; delayed proposals enter N2-EQ-LOW-TYPE-ONLY at posterior zero.
belief_system.zero_probability: After any null proposal, two weak no votes plus nonpivotal low-H-no/high-H-yes separation give the true-prior proposer s=z. No failure can pay the true low type below z, and y=0 forces failure, so L3=z is exact.
belief_system.atomless_convention: Bayes holds on positive-measure proposal events and F_i-almost everywhere; every exact null proposal has a pointwise belief and pure deviations use the true prior.
belief_system.weak_vote_passive_lemma: Derived only on path; counterfactual vote vectors may carry different explicit beliefs.

equilibrium_records.existence_uniqueness_status: Exists universally and includes all local pure branches, the low-only/delay tie family, and their identity products. Packages, slack, branch-internal mixing, constructive delay ballots, and beliefs remain multiple.
equilibrium_records.selection_status: Accepted support has common tie-break-minimal Y_i. The low-only/delay tie has equal proposer and expected-H payoffs. Pooling cannot mix locally with either lower-H branch.
equilibrium_records.recognized_proposer_payoff: V_i=lambda_i^L*R_i^L+lambda_i^P*R_i^P+lambda_i^D*a0, with local masses restricted by the stated option set.

correspondence_cells.domain_conditions: m>=3 and 0<nu<=nu_2. Define d=(1-nu)*a0>=z, g=d, p, s=(1-nu)*z, and L3=s.

equilibrium_records.admissibility_conditions: Pooling and delay both always exist. Pooling support has s<=R_i<=p, Y_i>=beta*o_1, every x_j>=z, feasibility, and common (R_i,Y_i); equality R_i=s requires Y_i=beta*o_1. Delay yields d. Each identity selects pure pooling or pure delay; no within-identity cross-branch mixture survives because delay gives H the strictly lower low-only continuation.
equilibrium_records.branch_classification: complete positive-prior low-N2 m>=3 correspondence: universal pooling and delay, no pure separation, no local cross-branch tie, and full Cartesian identity closure

strategy_profile.recognized_weak_proposers: Each identity selects pooling support with common (R_i,Y_i) or delay support yielding d.
strategy_profile.local_option_set: Pure pooling or pure delay. Cross-identity products retain any assignment of these two local options.
strategy_profile.weak_nonproposer_ballot: Yes on pooling. Delay uses H rejection with y<beta*o_0, exactly one weak rejector with x_j<d, or, when nu<nu_2, two or more weak rejectors. At nu=nu_2 only the exactly-one-rejector and H-rejection constructors survive.

hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_0: Pools with theta_1: yes on pooling; no in H-rejection delay; yes after weak rejection.
hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_1: Same on-path action as theta_0; positive-prior separation is impossible.

strategy_profile.proposal_mixing: Degenerate, discrete, or atomless within the selected branch. There is no local pool/delay mixture, but identities combine different branches by Cartesian product in one global assessment.

belief_system.on_path: Pooling passes. Delay preserves posterior nu and enters N2-EQ-LOW-TYPE-ONLY. Weak votes add no information.
belief_system.zero_probability: Two weak no votes and nonpivotal off-path H separation implement s=(1-nu)z after every null proposal. Conditional N2 payoff minima and a y=0 forced-failure package establish L3=s exactly.
belief_system.atomless_convention: Bayes holds on positive-measure proposal events and F_i-almost everywhere; exact null proposals retain pointwise beliefs and deviations use the true prior.
belief_system.weak_vote_passive_lemma: Derived on path only; no off-path passivity is assumed.

equilibrium_records.existence_uniqueness_status: Exists for every parameter vector. Pooling and delay are universal local options; packages, branch-internal mixing, identity products, slack, delay constructors, and beliefs remain set-valued.
equilibrium_records.selection_status: Accepted support has common tie-break-minimal Y_i. Delay gives H strictly less at a proposer-payoff tie, so pooling and delay cannot share one identity's support; identity heterogeneity remains admissible.
equilibrium_records.recognized_proposer_payoff: V_i=lambda_i^P*R_i^P+lambda_i^D*d, with each identity choosing one pure local branch.

correspondence_cells.domain_conditions: m>=3 and nu_2<nu<=1. Define d=(1-nu)*a0<z, g=z, p, s=(1-nu)*z, and L3=s.

equilibrium_records.admissibility_conditions: Pooling and delay both always exist. Pooling support has s<=R_i<=p, Y_i>=beta*o_1, every x_j>=z, feasibility, and common (R_i,Y_i); equality R_i=s requires Y_i=beta*o_1. Delay yields z. A local pooling/delay mixture is admissible exactly at R_i=z and Y_i=beta*o_1.
equilibrium_records.branch_classification: complete high-N2 m>=3 correspondence: universal pooling and delay, the pooling/delay tie, no pure separation, and full Cartesian proposer-identity closure

strategy_profile.recognized_weak_proposers: Each identity selects pooling, delay, or any mixture of the two at the common boundary (R_i,Y_i)=(z,beta*o_1).
strategy_profile.local_option_set: Pure pooling, pure delay, or the full pooling/delay proposal-mixture interval at equal proposer and H payoffs.
strategy_profile.weak_nonproposer_ballot: Yes on pooling. Delay uses H rejection with y<beta*o_1, with arbitrary nonnegative weak coordinates supportable through counterfactual vectors, or exactly one weak rejector j with x_j<z. Multiple weak rejectors are eliminated by T^Y in this region.

hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_0: Pools with theta_1: yes on pooling; no in H-rejection delay; yes after weak rejection.
hegemon_ballot_by_type.theta_1: Same on-path action as theta_0; T^Y resolves pooling-boundary and nonpivotal continuation equalities.

strategy_profile.proposal_mixing: Degenerate, discrete, or atomless mixing within branches and across pooling/delay only at the stated tie. Identity-specific local choices combine by Cartesian product.

belief_system.on_path: Pooling passes. Delay preserves posterior nu and enters N2-EQ-POOLING; weak actions are uninformative.
belief_system.zero_probability: Two weak no votes plus nonpivotal off-path H separation cap every null proposal at s=(1-nu)z. Conditional N2 payoff minima and a y=0 forced-failure package prove L3=s exactly.
belief_system.atomless_convention: Bayes holds on positive-measure proposal events and F_i-almost everywhere; every exact null proposal has a pointwise belief and pure deviations use the true prior.
belief_system.weak_vote_passive_lemma: Derived on path only; no off-path passive-belief restriction is imposed.

equilibrium_records.existence_uniqueness_status: Exists universally. Pooling, delay, their local tie mixtures, and every Cartesian identity product are retained; packages, slack, constructive ballots, branch-internal mixing, and beliefs remain multiple.
equilibrium_records.selection_status: Accepted support has common tie-break-minimal Y_i. Pooling and delay may share support only at proposer payoff z and H payoff beta*o_1. No additional selection is imposed.
